motion.name: selection-focus-easing
motion.purpose: Frame-independent selection, focus and pointer interpolation; immediate under reduced motion or explicit keyboard presentation.

motion.name: deck-yaw
motion.purpose: Shared yaw, pointer influence and selection turn in radians; zero under reduced motion.

motion.name: deck-pitch
motion.purpose: Small common pitch; zero under reduced motion.

motion.name: deck-float
motion.value: x += sin(orbitTime * 0.37) * 0.13; y += sin(orbitTime * 0.65) * 0.16; z += sin(orbitTime * 0.45) * 0.38
motion.purpose: World-unit assembly travel after pivot correction; each term is multiplied by (1 - focusAmount) and disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: gather-turn
motion.value: turn = sin(fraction * PI)^2; spread = (1 - focusAmount) * (1 - turn * 0.74)
motion.purpose: Gather between continuous selections; reduced motion sets turn to zero.

motion.name: idle-stop
motion.value: orbitTime advances only when !reducedMotion && !motionPaused && !inspecting && !pointerDown; render exits while hidden/offscreen.
motion.purpose: Stop idle movement during pause, inspection, interaction, reduced motion or invisibility.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: CSS animation/transition duration .01ms; iteration count 1. Scene selection/focus immediate; yaw, pitch and float zero.
motion.purpose: Update the existing controller in place; preserve independent film playback and hide the redundant Motion button.

responsive.header: Desktop/tablet base76px; phone base80px; plus top safe-area inset. Horizontal padding is max(page gutter, safe-area inset).
responsive.stage: --pin-height: max(480px, calc(100dvh - var(--header-size))); sticky top: var(--header-size). Canvas flexes between nonshrinking toolbar and caption.
responsive.caption: Wide: 1fr auto 1fr, minimum104px, padding18px 0 calc(24px + bottom safe inset). <=1200px: 1fr auto. <=767px: one column, gap14px, minimum144px, top padding16px.
responsive.scroll: Track = pin-height + (work-count - 1) * scroll-step. Step = clamp(220px, 32svh, 320px), or 220px at <=767px; native vertical scroll and touch-action: pan-y.
responsive.flat: Three columns/gap26px; <=767px two columns/gap16px; <=440px one column. Images/videos width100%, height auto.
responsive.biography: Columns .85fr 1fr, gap clamp(48px, 9vw, 150px); <=1200px gap48px; <=767px one column/gap36px. Portrait3:4 cover fit, max-height700px (680px phone).
responsive.statistics: Three equal columns. Desktop margins100px gutter140px; phone68px gutter80px. Phone values clamp(36px, 9vw, 64px).
responsive.typography: Phone biography name clamp(64px, 16vw, 96px), role15px, identity11px/500 with .025em tracking, identity role10px/max-width116px, nav12px. View labels11px; selected title18px; counts/metadata11px.
responsive.narrow: Below360px: nav gap8px; email16px; inspect/playback11px; playback text hidden, aria-label retained, min-width44px.
responsive.clipping: Canvas clips peripheral cards; html/body overflow-x:clip. The corrected projected ensemble balances around the active anchor without reducing scale; active/focused work stays complete.

geometry.mediaPlane: height = min(4.7, 4.8 / aspect); width = height * aspect; corner = min(width,height) * .035; ShapeGeometry curveSegments8.
geometry.frontPivot: frontAnchor = (0,0,2.2); deck.position = frontAnchor - rotated(frontAnchor), then idle float. Projected peripheral bounds are balanced around that floating anchor in camera-horizontal space.
geometry.camera: PerspectiveCamera(28, 1, 0.1, 100); position(0,0,fitDistance), lookAt(0,0,0). Steady during idle; distance interpolates expanded/focused framing.
geometry.focus: Selected plane remains opaque at z2.2 and scale1; others gather, scale toward .65 and fade with 1-focusAmount. Natural aspect retained.
geometry.centering: centerComposition projects every retained plane corner, then compositionOffset solves the projected horizontal bounds midpoint against the floating front anchor. Eighteen bisection steps search offsets from -8 to 8; settled active weight0, peripheral weight min(abs(relativeTo(index, displayedProgress)),1). Offset is multiplied by (1-focusAmount); full focus skips correction above .999.
geometry.centeringInvariant: Apply horizontal corrections after resetting normal plane placement each render, preserving camera distance, dimensions, scale, shared orientation, depth and float. Continuous weights avoid jumps between selected indices; the settled active work is not shifted or shrunk.

rendering.cadence: FRAME_INTERVAL = 1000 / 30: nominal30fps cadence with immediate dirty/event updates, not a universal hard ceiling.
rendering.visibility: Hidden/offscreen scene cancels RAF and pauses film. Flat films remove src and load() when hidden/offscreen.
rendering.lifecycle: Dispose displaced textures/geometries/materials, old VideoTexture/media element, listeners, observers and renderer.
rendering.fallback: Renderer failure, WebGL context loss or preview error exposes complete Flat archive and status notice.

behavior.gallery: Native scroll, horizontal drag and Previous/Next share selection/document position. ArrowLeft/Right and Home/End select immediately. Enter toggles inspection; Escape exits; Space toggles selected film.
behavior.order: 29 supplied works:18 photographs and11 films, shuffled once per load; shared order across Stack/Flat.
behavior.playback: Selected spatial film muted, looping, playsInline. Click/Space/Retry forwards synchronously via playbackRef -> controller.setPaused -> video.play(). Motion pause is independent.
behavior.flatPlayback: Intersection ratio >=.12 allows visible autoplay; hidden/offscreen clears source. Play calls video directly; error Retry increments attempt and reinitializes its effect lifecycle.
behavior.accessibility: Real buttons; pressed states; visible focus; named region; polite atomic selected-work announcements; accessible names retained when labels hide.
behavior.supportingContent: Statistics/contact independent of optional ABOUT_ME portraits; loading/unavailable portrait preserves biography.

evidence.scope: Fresh final reviewer inspected four reference-frame PNGs, all24 corrected captures and four retained Flat/Contact captures. Documenter reconciled the frozen centering source, snippets and mappings against that accepted review; no new visual audit was performed. Behavioral results are attributed to the verification packet.
evidence.checks: Final Playwright32passed; full ESLint, TypeScript --noEmit and production build passed. Documenter did not rerun checks.
evidence.centeringEvidence: 390px yaw visible-area centroid40.77% ->49.68%; visible coverage51.96% ->56.29%, without shrinking. Six sizes include440x956 as a surrogate; exact in-app viewport was unavailable.
evidence.status: Final visual review and design documentation complete for the corrected implementation, before the user's requested main-branch commit. Git integration is handled by the coordinator; user will run Vercel deployment.
evidence.limits: Reviewer did not play the source MP4 or corrected motion WebM. Static/source acceptance does not independently establish temporal fidelity, exact in-app framing or physical iOS/iPad Safari/Instagram performance. Shared Chrome retained reduced motion; normal-motion evidence uses separate explicit contexts.
evidence.runtimeChanges: No documenter application, test, asset or media edits; no new browser, tests, build or detector runs.

narrative.overview:
Real photographs and films form a dense, balanced, rounded deck on a neutral black field. Overlap, shallow shared rotation and gentle assembly movement give the work depth; quiet upright DIN Pro keeps navigation and captions secondary to the media.

The accepted composition prioritizes phone portrait and portrait iPad. Peripheral cards may extend beyond the stage edges, while the selected work stays centered and fitted and the individual view reveals its complete natural aspect ratio. The same neutral surfaces, small corners and restrained controls continue through Flat view, statistics, biography and contact.
keyCharacteristics: Real media supplies the color; the surrounding interface stays neutral.
Rounded overlapping planes create depth without a floor or ornamental frame.
Large media and compact controls lead on phone and portrait iPad.
Native scrolling, an isolated work view and a complete Flat archive remain available.

rules.name: The Media Color Rule
rules.body: Keep interface selection, navigation and focus neutral so the supplied photographs and films remain the source of expressive color.

rules.name: The Portrait Framing Rule
rules.body: Balance the surrounding cards around the selected front plane without shrinking the gallery. Allow peripheral cards to clip at the stage edge; keep the selected work fitted, the inspected work complete, and captions and controls within the usable viewport.

rules.name: The Assembly Motion Rule
rules.body: Move the deck as one assembly around its selected front plane; keep the camera steady during idle motion and stop idle movement when paused, inspecting, interacting, hidden, offscreen or under reduced motion.

dos: Do preserve the supplied work's color and natural aspect ratio in the gallery and Flat archive.
Do retain centered, complete selected and inspected media while allowing peripheral deck bleed.
Do keep phone and portrait iPad controls, selected-work information and contact navigation usable.
Do retain separate motion and film controls, live reduced-motion support and the complete Flat fallback.
donts: Don't restore the superseded orange accents, sharp focus brackets, floor grid or oversized archive headline.
Don't crop the selected gallery work or let peripheral bleed create horizontal document scrolling.
Don't add idle camera bob or automatic selection changes that interrupt inspection.
Don't put captions or decorative interface frames on the Three.js image planes.
